notes:
Primary contact: Javier Morales (Head of Ops). Use-case: replace brittle Lambda glue that calls Zendesk + Stripe. Wants a single inference runtime that can call tools (create/update tickets, issue refunds, escalate to manager Slack channel) with strong auditability. Key quotes: "We lose customer trust when refunds are duplicated or tickets are duplicated; need idempotent tool-calls and clear audit trail."

POC ask: 2-week evaluation using Dedicated pool or Private (VPC) with connectors to Zendesk and Stripe sandbox. Objectives: 1) validate >200 concurrent agents during simulated spike (target 500 rps internal) with <250ms median token latency for assistant suggestions; 2) validate at-least-once vs exactly-once semantics for critical tool-calls; 3) verify RBAC for tool-calls (agent vs supervisor actions) and audit logs exported to their SIEM.

Security notes: legal requires KMS/HSM integration for key wraps, SSO via Okta (SAML), and ability to set retention rules per customer region (EU/US). Data residency: EU customer subset must be routed to EU region and logs masked.

Integration notes: currently using Zendesk (primary ticket store), ServiceNow for some enterprise clients, Stripe for payments/refunds. Existing infra: VPC peering available, on-prem logging collector (Splunk).

Tactical: we proposed a stubbed tool layer in POC to simulate eventual external rate limits, plus fallback policy to queue tool-calls and surface a supervisor approval workflow. Customer asked for webhook retry/backoff strategy and a visible deduplication key on every tool invocation.

Sales notes: high conversion potential if POC passes legal/security; upsell path to Dedicated + Optimize for batching suggestions and KV caching. Stakeholders: Head of Ops (Javier Morales), CTO (Leila Ahmed), Head of Legal (Markus Vogel).
requirements_summary:
- Workloads: agent assist + ticket summarization + automated refunds via tool-calls
- Perf targets: <250ms median suggest latency, sustain 500 rps during spikes for assistant actions, 50 tps for ticket create/update
- Reliability: graceful degradation with queued tool-calls, automatic fallback model variants, alerting when tool-call errors >0.5%
- Security: SSO/SAML, KMS for keys, audit logs to SIEM, tenant routing to EU for data residency
- Tool behavior: idempotent create/update, dedupe keys, supervisor approval flow for refunds >$200, RBAC enforced on tool invocation
deal_notes: Economics: likely 12-24 month contract. Customer prefers predictable capacity for support spikes. Interested in pilot pricing for Dedicated pool + security add-on. Legal asked for sample DPA and encryption diagram. AE to share pricing deck and SAML integration runbook (drive links provided).
